name: otari-router
description: Asks an Otari gateway which model each Claude Code subagent should run on, and starts it there.

otari_url.title: Otari URL
otari_url.description: Base URL of the gateway that recommends the model, such as https://otari.example.com. Plain http only for a gateway on this machine.

otari_api_key.title: Otari API key
otari_api_key.description: The key each recommendation is billed to.
